note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the Orient UK front photo (42.0 mm case, Orient UK; strap 22.1 mm measured against 22 mm). Heights before the house depth scale (11.8 mm thick listing, domed crystal, no side photo: estimated as FAC0000CA0). House method: modelled polished steel case, bezel, lugs and crown, polished rose gold tone hands and batons; the photo map serves only the dial print, the ORIENT letters and the brown suede strap.

case.note: [kind, offset, z]: round rings about the pivot, 'case' = offset from the 42.0 mm case, 'crystal' = offset from the crystal opening (18.33 mm radius, inner edge of the polished bezel in the photo). Flank, rounded shoulder, polished bezel rising inward to the crystal seat, inner lip

lug.note: one lug, mirrored to all four: tip, inner edge and outer offset by depth below the tip from the trace (mean of the four photo lugs); top slopes down to the tip

rehaut.note: polished ring from the dial edge (16.85 mm) up to the crystal seat: the bright band inside the bezel in the photo

crystal.note: high domed crystal (Bambino): straight wall to 8.6 mm, dome to 11.6 mm at the centre (11.8 mm listed thickness)

dial.note: flat dial to the dial edge; minute track, sub-dials, date and print in the photo map

applied.note: tapered faceted batons: polished rose gold tone plates from the photo outlines (convex hull); ORIENT letters: raised plates with the photo on them

hands.note: faceted dauphine hour and minute with pointed tails, seconds needle with a straight tail and a red end, ridge on the tip-tail axis: polished rose gold tone (photo)

seconds.note: red end of the seconds hand (photo: from 257 px)

crown.note: fluted crown on the 3 o'clock axis: 5.4 mm across, 2.8 mm from the case flank (photo)

strap.note: 22 mm brown suede on a black leather backing, house curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end = tip + 2.2 x radius; starts under the case. UVs from the photo's straight strap: the case edge on the centre line (trace strap_mm case_y) to photo_past_tip past the lug tip, folded back and forth; photo_past_tip 1.0: past that the photo's strap narrows toward the top edge (white corners)

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: case, bezel, rehaut, lugs and crown

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

rose_gold.note: rose gold tone hands and batons (listing, photo)

red.note: red end of the seconds hand (photo)

review.subtitle: Bambino Version 4, 42 mm: polished steel, grey sunburst dial, rose gold tone batons and dauphine hands, red-tipped seconds, high domed crystal, brown suede strap. Front relief GLB.
notes: Round 1, house method: case, bezel, lugs and crown are modelled in the house polished steel; hands and batons are modelled polished rose gold tone, the seconds hand with its red end; the photo is used only for the dial print, the ORIENT letters and the suede strap.
Front photo from Orient UK (straight-on, the watch about 1000 px across). Heights are estimated from the 11.8 mm listing (no side photo).
The buckle is left out. The strap curls under at both ends, like the other tracker watches.
